due_when.clears_when: training-rerun-5m.yml no longer pushes to non-main branches, with a workflow-shape test

what: training-rerun-5m.yml commits its TRAINING-RESULTS back to whatever branch triggered it (checkout ref github.ref_name, `git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}`, lines 17/44/92), so a push to ANY session branch that touches its paths gets a bot commit on that branch. MEASURED 2026-09-27: de197a3 landed on claude/great-faraday-f7r361 (manager register branch) and 8d573d3 on claude/ca-wave-b-landing (#13226), where it conflicted with main's own copy of the same 4 experiments/2026-05-07-vwap-accuracy/results/5m files and stalled the Wave-B audit landing ~1h. Proposed Tier-1 fix: restrict the workflow's push trigger to main (or commit results only via commit-to-main), and never push to a claude/* branch.
